system.description:
The watcher's poisonous gaze.

Cannot make Extra Attacks.

On hit, the victim is Poisoned for 2 turns; each further hit adds 2 more turns. A Poisoned unit has their Bld reduced by 5 and suffers 1d6 Decay damage at the start of each of their turns. No effect if the target is Protected against Decay damage.
This unit cannot become Grounded. It is always airborne.
Protected from Shadow damage. Vulnerable to Piercing, Missile, Wind and Holy damage.
